notes: Part 5 of 7 in the Collaboration Restructure program (Docs/COLLAB_RESTRUCTURE_PLAN.md); Parts 1, 4 and 2 (which absorbed 3) have shipped. LOCKED 2026-08-12. Four items: (1) campaign total_budget becomes DERIVED from set allocations and the Step-1 budget field goes; (2) end_date NEVER asked — derived as the latest posting-window end among engagement/hybrid sets, so an all-conversion campaign simply has none (founder 2026-08-12: a sales campaign has a start date and NO end date, not an optional blank). No publish gate needed: a paid set always has a window, so a paid campaign always has an end date; (3) a new explicit End campaign -> completed, distinct from cancel's abort, guarded on pending tranches + deliverables awaiting review, with creators notified because completing removes their products from follower discovery; (4) a NULL end date renders as 'Ongoing' everywhere instead of an em-dash. No migration: campaigns.end_date is already nullable in prod. Two decisions requested at lock, both answered with a recommendation in 01-spec.md §6: budget = derive (not ceiling, not drop), hybrid = windowed.

founder_refinement_2026_08_12.quote: as far as dates is concern, its simple that is if the campaign type is conversions or sales then it might be start date but no end date. but for offers it may have end date (this we addressed already)
founder_refinement_2026_08_12.effect: End date stops being an optional field and becomes a derived one. Sales campaigns have no end-date field at all.
founder_refinement_2026_08_12.trap_avoided: Deriving the campaign end date from set posting windows — the symmetrical move to the budget derivation — would have ended a SALES campaign on its post-by date and removed every product from the follower app while stock remained. Verified that every set requires a posting window regardless of aim (page.js:793-794, :1373), so only engagement/hybrid windows may date a campaign. Asserted as B5b and W3.3 precisely because the derivation looks obviously right until you notice sales sets carry windows too.
founder_refinement_2026_08_12.three_clocks: when the creator must post (set window, all aims) · how long selling runs (campaign end date; sales = none) · when a discount expires (offer, already delivered in Parts 1 and 4)

mixed_campaign_rule.rule: If ANY set is conversion, the campaign has NO end date. Only an all-paid campaign gets one — the latest posting-window end among its sets.
mixed_campaign_rule.why: The first draft took the latest paid window regardless. A worked example in the founder walkthrough exposed it: a sales set posting by 15 Sep alongside a paid set posting by 31 Oct would date the campaign 31 Oct, and on 1 Nov the SALES products would leave the follower app — a paid set silently imposing a deadline on open-ended selling. The sales aim now wins on dates exactly as it does on budget (which sums only paid sets).
mixed_campaign_rule.verified_safe: tranche-3-release.job.js:42 releases N days after escrow_entries.triggered_at, NOT after the campaign end date, so an undated campaign still pays every creator on schedule. The only thing an undated paid campaign loses is cron auto-completion — which is what the explicit End provides.
